evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts

observations.why: Directive issued in the present demands erasure of specific named artifacts (fleet, contracts), projecting a desired state that does not yet obtain — irrealis modality with concrete referents.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes

observations.why: Present-tense directive seeking a state change that is not yet actual; 'all knowledge' and 'routes' generalize beyond any single artifact into a category-level erasure.
